cleared.check: Task 1 (L-1036): mined transactions with receipt status 0 that entered the PoolManager, inside the cycle 23 replay windows, replayed from their own prestate through the cycle 23 source model (cycle 23 scripts/model.py) with failed frames rolled back as the EVM does, and every failed PoolManager frame classified as a source revert, an out of gas, or unexplained. Ethereum: trace_filter over the whole window 26,495,694 to 26,497,048 (eth.api.pocket.network). The other nine: eth_getBlockReceipts on 400 blocks drawn with seed 24 from the blocks that hold a window transaction (500 recent blocks with seed 25 on BNB Smart Chain, whose public endpoints keep state for hours), filtered to the 60 most used entry contracts of the window and the PoolManager, then up to 300 failed receipts per network drawn with seed 7 and traced with callTracer and prestateTracer.
cleared.result: No failed PoolManager frame is unexplained on any of the ten networks. Ethereum: 194 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 194 traced, 194 entered the PoolManager (0 never did, 0 could not be traced); of those, 79 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 138 source reverts and 3 out of gas, 0 unexplained. Base: 473 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 300 traced, 58 entered the PoolManager (242 never did, 0 could not be traced); of those, 51 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 10 source reverts and 0 out of gas, 0 unexplained. Unichain: 895 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 300 traced, 55 entered the PoolManager (21 never did, 224 could not be traced); of those, 34 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 29 source reverts and 0 out of gas, 0 unexplained. Arbitrum One: 1074 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 300 traced, 46 entered the PoolManager (238 never did, 16 could not be traced); of those, 25 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 38 source reverts and 0 out of gas, 0 unexplained. BNB Smart Chain: 133 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 133 traced, 2 entered the PoolManager (43 never did, 88 could not be traced); of those, 2 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 0 source reverts and 0 out of gas, 0 unexplained. Avalanche: 713 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 300 traced, 25 entered the PoolManager (271 never did, 4 could not be traced); of those, 18 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 9 source reverts and 1 out of gas, 0 unexplained. Polygon: 573 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 300 traced, 85 entered the PoolManager (215 never did, 0 could not be traced); of those, 78 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 6 source reverts and 2 out of gas, 0 unexplained. Monad: 70 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 70 traced, 36 entered the PoolManager (34 never did, 0 could not be traced); of those, 15 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 21 source reverts and 0 out of gas, 0 unexplained. MegaETH: 506 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 300 traced, 106 entered the PoolManager (194 never did, 0 could not be traced); of those, 60 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 46 source reverts and 0 out of gas, 0 unexplained. HyperEVM: 7 failed receipts among the entry contracts, 7 traced, 4 entered the PoolManager (3 never did, 0 could not be traced); of those, 1 failed outside every PoolManager frame, and the failed PoolManager frames are 3 source reverts and 3 out of gas, 0 unexplained. A source revert here is one the model raises from the replayed state with the same error (PriceLimitAlreadyExceeded, CurrencyNotSettled, PoolNotInitialized), a failed child carried up byte for byte by unlock (src/PoolManager.sol:110) or wrapped in WrappedError naming that child (src/libraries/Hooks.sol:131-137, src/types/Currency.sol:44-86), or one unlock whose callback returned 0 bytes, which do not ABI-decode as bytes at src/PoolManager.sol:110 (Ethereum 0x473141491726885afa424e614e5c0b53c365f3c4ce0533e97dad225c2d6bdc32); in all 192,815 successful unlocks stored by cycles 23 and 24 the callback return decodes. The out of gas frames are swaps given 4,337 to 221,156 gas and two unlocks that carry an out of gas callback. One Ethereum take is counted as a source revert: its USDC transfer stopped at the EIP-2200 SSTORE sentry inside USDC for lack of gas, and Currency.transfer wrapped that failure (src/types/Currency.sol:82-86). No failed frame is a burn, a modifyLiquidity or a take with a reason other than these. The successful PoolManager frames inside the failed transactions were compared word by word as in cycle 23 (outputs and hook calldata; the tracer clears logs under a failed frame) with no mismatch. The 2 BNB Smart Chain transactions that entered the PoolManager both failed outside it.

cleared.check: Task 2 (L-1035): the 3,135 caught PoolManager frames in the 20,000 MegaETH transactions of cycle 23, grouped by revert data and by the frame where the revert started, and replayed through the source model; then whether a mega-evm v1.7.4 resource limit (compute gas, data size, KV updates, state growth) can stop a frame after take has paid out and before settle while the outer transaction succeeds.
cleared.result: All 3,135 are unlock frames. 3,091 carry a revert that started in the caller's own unlockCallback after the PoolManager calls inside it returned: 2,997 frames with selector 0x17080d7e from 0x00000000c070d95ed0f9c86de3b51e740c263ef8, 86 with 0xecbd9804 from 0x94bdc671f0c35f44a1daa53143fd1f868d1623b9 and 8 with 0xbbd6b10b from 0x16b424408f3a12dcbe2045b07a9cd2b9f52038db, each one word holding the swap delta the callback just received, the quote-by-revert pattern. unlock carries them unchanged (src/PoolManager.sol:110). The other 44 are AlreadyUnlocked from nested unlock calls by 0xb18bcb4cf0690202d022bd3b4b86d5cfecf05489, 0x3aaf3c5befcde71962b138e5cd767c547c55137b and 0xb6df2bb754417fd3b726061633e43fa61b8a3edf, which the model raises from the replayed state (src/PoolManager.sol:105). The rate is one searcher contract on one network. MegaLimitExceeded(uint8,uint64) has selector 0x84b90267 and appears in none of the 521,190 frames of the 20,281 stored MegaETH transactions, and every one of the 12,133 failed frames has the error string execution reverted. In mega-evm v1.7.4 a frame-local exceed found during execution returns Revert (limit/limit.rs:152-161) and revm reverts that frame's journal, and a transaction-level exceed halts every frame and the transaction (limit.rs:31-41, 852-860). take and settle are separate frames inside the callback, and the PoolManager only returns from unlock when NonzeroDeltaCount is 0 (src/PoolManager.sol:112). A stopped take frame takes its transfer and its delta back with it. A stopped callback makes unlock revert. The one case the source comments name, a frame that already committed and is reported as Revert (limit.rs:833-837), leaves the PoolManager books consistent, because a committed take frame recorded its debit (src/PoolManager.sol:291-297) and every PoolManager child failure makes the PoolManager revert its own frame (Hooks.sol:137, Currency.sol:51-53, 82-86, 94). Cycle 10 reached the same reading on v1.7.3. No limit stops a frame between take and settle while the outer transaction succeeds with other users' funds moved.

cleared.check: Task 3 (L-1025): successful PoolManager transactions without a PoolManager log, replayed word by word from their prestate as cycle 23 did (outputs, every changed PoolManager storage word from prestateTracer diffMode, and the native balance against native settles minus takes and fee collection). Ethereum: all 1,017 trace_filter hits outside the window got receipts; 823 succeeded with no PoolManager log and 400 drawn with seed 7 were replayed. Base, Monad, MegaETH, HyperEVM: up to 400 successful receipts outside the window and without a PoolManager log, from the block sample of Task 1, traced with callTracer and kept when a frame enters the PoolManager.
cleared.result: Every one replays. Ethereum 400 transactions, 2015 words compared, native balance as expected in all 400; the frames are extsload, exttload, unlock, sync, settle, take, updateDynamicLPFee (no event in src/PoolManager.sol:339-346), protocolFeeController, one mint and 28 swaps inside caught callbacks. Base 18 of 400 entered the PoolManager, 75 words. Monad 2 of 400, 19 words. MegaETH 175 of 400, 190 words, all caught quote-by-revert unlocks. HyperEVM 0 of 19 candidates entered the PoolManager. No storage, output or native mismatch. None of the replayed transactions called clear, burn, collectProtocolFees or setProtocolFee; those remain without a mined example in this unit.

cleared.check: Task 4a: the opposite direction. The whole cycle 23 replay set rerun through the same model with failed frames replayed and rolled back instead of skipped, to see whether the model predicts a revert for any PoolManager frame that succeeded on chain, and to classify every caught PoolManager revert in successful transactions.
cleared.result: 163758 successful transactions, 4046074 words compared, 3838 caught PoolManager frames. The model raises no revert for any frame that succeeded on chain (no model-reverted record on any network), and every caught frame is a source revert or an out of gas (5 out of gas frames, all Monad swaps given 14,000 to 140,000 gas). The other caught reverts are bubbled callback errors, SafeCastOverflow from take with an amount above int128 (Ethereum, 18), SwapAmountCannotBeZero (Base, 166), PoolAlreadyInitialized, PriceLimitAlreadyExceeded, AlreadyUnlocked and calls to selectors the PoolManager does not have. The native balance check holds in every transaction. The one storage-unexplained word on HyperEVM is the cycle 23 transaction without a prestate.

cleared.check: Task 4b: the failed transactions of Task 1 executed again on a second endpoint. First at their own position with debug_traceTransaction callTracer, comparing every PoolManager frame (input, output, error) and the root result. Then as asked, eth_call of the same from, to, input, value and gas at the parent block.
cleared.result: At their own position: Ethereum 191 identical of 194 (second endpoint https://eth.drpc.org, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc); Base 58 identical of 58 (second endpoint https://base.drpc.org, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc); Unichain 0 identical of 55 (second endpoint https://unichain.api.pocket.network, op-reth/v2.9.0-72fcf947/x86_64-linux); Arbitrum One 0 identical of 46 (second endpoint https://arbitrum.drpc.org, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc); Avalanche 2 identical of 25 (second endpoint https://avalanche.drpc.org, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc); Polygon 0 identical of 85 (second endpoint https://poly.api.pocket.network, bor/host-85-195-124-57.example.com/v2.11.2/linux-amd64/go1.26.11); Monad 36 identical of 36 (second endpoint https://rpc1.monad.xyz, Monad/0.16.7); MegaETH 106 identical of 106 (second endpoint https://megaeth.drpc.org, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc); HyperEVM 4 identical of 4 (second endpoint https://hyperliquid.drpc.org, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc). Unichain (pruned state on pocket op-reth v2.9.0), Arbitrum One (no debug on drpc), Polygon (no debug on pocket bor v2.11.2) and BNB Smart Chain (missing trie node) served no second trace, and Avalanche answered 2 of 25. Where a second trace came, every one is identical. The eth_call at the parent block gives: Ethereum {"reverts-other-data": 24, "success": 84, "tx-not-found": 17, "same-revert-data": 68, "exactParent:reverts-other-data": 7, "endpoint-error": 1}; Base {"same-revert-data": 23, "success": 30, "reverts-other-data": 5}; Unichain {"success": 40, "same-revert-data": 15}; Arbitrum One {"success": 17, "endpoint-error": 21, "same-revert-data": 8}; BNB Smart Chain {"endpoint-error": 2}; Avalanche {"success": 16, "same-revert-data": 8, "reverts-other-data": 1}; Polygon {"reverts-other-data": 12, "same-revert-data": 43, "success": 30}; Monad {"success": 13, "reverts-other-data": 16, "same-revert-data": 6, "tx-not-found": 1}; MegaETH {"reverts-other-data": 52, "success": 19, "same-revert-data": 9, "tx-not-found": 26}; HyperEVM {"success": 3, "tx-not-found": 1}. Apart from 7 on Ethereum, no failed transaction sits at index 0, so the parent state misses the earlier transactions of the same block, which the searchers and routers involved race against; a success or other revert data there reflects ordering and is no evidence of a client difference. The 7 Ethereum transactions at index 0 all go to the searcher contract 0x0000000aa232009084bd71a5797d089aa4edfad4. Mined, they reverted with Panic 0x11 inside its unlockCallback after its PoolManager calls had returned. On the parent block they revert with 0xd8a6b89b, a selector declared nowhere in src/, which eth_call raises with the parent block number and timestamp. 6 of the 7 re-trace at their position frame for frame, and the seventh drew an endpoint error. drpc reports Geth/v10.0.0/drpc on every network, and Monad's second endpoint reports the same Monad/0.16.7 as the first and traces with the interpreter, so the builds behind those comparisons are unknown or the same.

leads.question: On the eleven networks without a cycle 23 replay, do mined failed PoolManager transactions replay to a source revert, an out of gas, or a failure outside the PoolManager, as on the ten networks here?
leads.why: This unit covered only the ten networks of the cycle 23 windows. A producer that reverts a valid withdrawal would show up only in failed receipts, and Arc and Elysium serve no traces.

leads.question: Can the failed PoolManager transactions of Task 1 on Unichain, Arbitrum One, Polygon and BNB Smart Chain be re-traced at their position on a second client build, for example from a public archive that serves debug_traceTransaction?
leads.why: No public endpoint gave a second trace for these four, so the failed set there rests on one endpoint each.

leads.question: Are there mined log-free PoolManager transactions that call clear, burn, collectProtocolFees or setProtocolFee, and do they replay?
leads.why: None of the 595 log-free transactions replayed in this unit called them; burn emits a Transfer log, so log-free burns would only appear when nested in a caught frame.

leadResults.answer: Failed transactions that entered the PoolManager on the ten networks: Ethereum the whole window, the others a sample of 400 window blocks. Every failed PoolManager frame is a source revert reproduced by the model from the replayed state or an out of gas, and the other failed transactions failed outside every PoolManager frame after the PoolManager returned what the model computes. Where a second endpoint re-traced them, the frames are identical.

The 3,135 caught MegaETH frames are 3,091 quote-by-revert callbacks from three searcher contracts, carried by unlock unchanged, and 44 AlreadyUnlocked. None carries MegaLimitExceeded, and in mega-evm v1.7.4 no resource limit can stop a frame between take and settle while the PoolManager returns from unlock with debts open.

Log-free successful PoolManager transactions on Ethereum (400), Base (18), Monad (2) and MegaETH (175) replay with no storage, output or native mismatch. HyperEVM had none in the sample. clear, burn, collectProtocolFees and setProtocolFee had no log-free example and stay open as a low lead.
